summary: This 8-K reports OCC approval of the bank-level merger between Webster Bank and Santander Bank, a step in the larger acquisition of Webster Financial Corp by Banco Santander S.A. Terms from prior announcement include an all-cash transaction at $64.50 per share (approx. $10.3B enterprise value). Boards of both companies had unanimously approved. Regulatory approvals remain from the Federal Reserve and ECB. Risk-arb focus: timeline to closing and any remaining antitrust hurdles.
